			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = temple_patronage } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:join_war }
			scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { is_alive = yes }
			NOT = { scope:qpq_deal_t_char = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
				NOT = { top_liege = scope:qpq_deal_t_char.top_liege }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				any_character_war = {
					qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
					NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = join_war } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:stay_out }
			scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_char
			scope:qpq_deal_t_char = { is_alive = yes }
			NOT = { scope:qpq_deal_t_char = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				any_character_war = {
					qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:qpq_deal_t_char }
					NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = stay_out } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:heavier_tribute }
			scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_tribute_can_rise
				scope:recipient = { tributary_contract_obligation_level_can_be_increased = default_tributary_taxes }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = heavier_tribute } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:lighter_tribute }
			scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_tribute_can_fall
				scope:actor = { tributary_contract_obligation_level_can_be_decreased = default_tributary_taxes }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = lighter_tribute } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:bought_freedom }
			scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = bought_freedom } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:accept_the_yoke }
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_tributary = no
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_can_be_tributary
				scope:recipient = { can_be_tributary_of = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = accept_the_yoke } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:cast_off_the_yoke }
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_tributary = yes
				exists = suzerain
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				NOT = { suzerain = scope:actor }
			}
			exists = scope:recipient.suzerain
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = cast_off_the_yoke } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_t_kind = flag:barter }
			NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			always = no
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = yes
	}
}

qpq_deal_leg_i_valid_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_kind }
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:chartered_conquest }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = chartered_conquest } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = sanctioned_conquest } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:marcher_charge }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_landed = yes NOT = { top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = marcher_charge } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:holy_sponsorship }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_title
			scope:qpq_deal_i_title = { NOT = { faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_agent_same_faith
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = holy_sponsorship } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:development_charter }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_title
			scope:qpq_deal_i_title = { tier = tier_county }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = development_charter } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:electoral_purchase }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}

			exists = scope:recipient.primary_title
			scope:recipient.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:actor } }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = electoral_purchase } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:loyal_mole }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = loyal_mole } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:agent_provocateur }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = agent_provocateur } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:licensed_feud }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { liege ?= scope:recipient is_landed = yes }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = licensed_feud } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:dossier }
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = dossier } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:quiet_removal }
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = {
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				NOT = { is_child_of = scope:recipient }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = quiet_removal } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:heir_question }
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = heir_question } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:snatch }
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = snatch } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:dispossession }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:actor = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { liege ?= scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = dispossession } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:the_cloister }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { has_trait = devoted } NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = the_cloister } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:marriage_by_command }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } is_married = no }
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_can_marry
				scope:actor = { can_marry_character_trigger = { CHARACTER = scope:qpq_deal_i_char } }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = marriage_by_command } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:hand_over }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = hand_over } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:hand_over_artifact }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:actor = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_artifact
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_artifact
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = hand_over_artifact } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:renunciation }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:actor = { any_claim = { always = yes } }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_title
			scope:actor = { has_claim_on = scope:qpq_deal_i_title }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = renunciation } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:hush_money }
			scope:actor = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
			scope:recipient = {
				any_secret = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = hush_money } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:price_of_loyalty }
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = price_of_loyalty } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:blessing_for_a_feud }
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { liege ?= scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = blessing_for_a_feud } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:clemency_bargain }
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor
				}
				any_known_secret = {
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = clemency_bargain } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:electoral_capitulation }
			exists = scope:recipient.primary_title
			scope:recipient.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:actor } }
			NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = electoral_capitulation } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:mutual_defense_league }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = mutual_defense_league } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:faction_pledge }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege
			scope:recipient = { exists = joined_faction joined_faction = { faction_target = scope:recipient.liege } }
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = faction_pledge } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:title_swap }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_title
			scope:qpq_deal_i_title = { tier = tier_county holder ?= scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = title_swap } }
		}

			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = pliant_patriarch } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:favourable_omens }
			scope:actor = {
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				faith = scope:recipient.faith
				OR = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					this = scope:recipient.realm_priest
				}
			}
			scope:recipient.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = favourable_omens } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:consecration_rites }
			scope:actor = {
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				faith = scope:recipient.faith
				OR = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					this = scope:recipient.realm_priest
				}
			}
			scope:recipient.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = consecration_rites } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:temple_patronage }
			scope:actor = {
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				faith = scope:recipient.faith
				OR = {
					is_clergy = yes
					government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
				}
			}
			NOT = { exists = scope:recipient.faith.religious_head }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = temple_patronage } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:join_war }
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			NOT = { scope:qpq_deal_i_char = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { top_liege = scope:qpq_deal_i_char.top_liege }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				any_character_war = {
					qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:qpq_deal_i_char }
					NOT = { is_participant = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = join_war } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:stay_out }
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_char
			scope:qpq_deal_i_char = { is_alive = yes }
			NOT = { scope:qpq_deal_i_char = scope:actor }
			scope:recipient = {
				any_character_war = {
					qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:qpq_deal_i_char }
					NOT = { is_participant = scope:actor }
				}
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = stay_out } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:heavier_tribute }
			scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_tribute_can_rise
				scope:actor = { tributary_contract_obligation_level_can_be_increased = default_tributary_taxes }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = heavier_tribute } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:lighter_tribute }
			scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_tribute_can_fall
				scope:recipient = { tributary_contract_obligation_level_can_be_decreased = default_tributary_taxes }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = lighter_tribute } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:bought_freedom }
			scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = bought_freedom } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:accept_the_yoke }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = yes
			}
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_tributary = no
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = qpq_valid_can_be_tributary
				scope:actor = { can_be_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = accept_the_yoke } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:cast_off_the_yoke }
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:actor = {
				is_tributary = yes
				exists = suzerain
				NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { suzerain = scope:recipient }
			}
			exists = scope:actor.suzerain
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
			NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = cast_off_the_yoke } }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_deal_i_kind = flag:barter }
			NOT = { scope:recipient = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
			scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		}
		trigger_else = {
			always = no
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = yes
	}
}

qpq_deal_gold_ok_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_deal_t_o_gold ?= yes
			NOT = { scope:qpq_deal_t_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		}
		scope:actor = { gold >= scope:qpq_deal_t_price }
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_deal_i_o_gold ?= yes
			NOT = { scope:qpq_deal_i_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		}
		scope:recipient = { gold >= scope:qpq_deal_i_price }
	}
	always = yes
}

qpq_deal_room_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_t_kind
			exists = scope:qpq_deal_i_kind
		}
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_list = qpq_pacts }
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_pacts value < qpq_pact_cap_minus_one_value }
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_list = qpq_pacts }
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_pacts value < qpq_pact_cap_minus_one_value }
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		qpq_both_have_pact_capacity_trigger = { ACTOR = scope:actor RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
	}
}

qpq_deal_valid_trigger = {
	qpq_deal_leg_t_valid_trigger = yes
	qpq_deal_leg_i_valid_trigger = yes
	qpq_deal_room_trigger = yes
	qpq_deal_gold_ok_trigger = yes
}

qpq_proposed_kind_is_agent_init_trigger = {
	OR = {
		scope:qpq_proposed_kind ?= flag:price_of_loyalty
		scope:qpq_proposed_kind ?= flag:electoral_capitulation
	}
}

qpq_proposed_kind_still_valid_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:chartered_conquest }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = chartered_conquest } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:sanctioned_conquest }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = sanctioned_conquest } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:marcher_charge }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes NOT = { top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = marcher_charge } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:holy_sponsorship }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = { NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_agent_same_faith
			scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = holy_sponsorship } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:development_charter }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:target
		scope:target = { tier = tier_county }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = development_charter } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:electoral_purchase }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}

		exists = scope:actor.primary_title
		scope:actor.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:recipient } }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = electoral_purchase } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:loyal_mole }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = loyal_mole } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:agent_provocateur }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = agent_provocateur } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:licensed_feud }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:actor is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = licensed_feud } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:dossier }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = dossier } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:quiet_removal }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			NOT = { is_child_of = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = quiet_removal } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:heir_question }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = heir_question } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:snatch }
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_courtier_of = scope:actor
			}
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } NOT = { this = scope:recipient } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = snatch } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:dispossession }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = dispossession } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:the_cloister }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { has_trait = devoted } NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = the_cloister } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:marriage_by_command }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:recipient } is_married = no }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_can_marry
			scope:recipient = { can_marry_character_trigger = { CHARACTER = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = marriage_by_command } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:hand_over }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = hand_over } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:hand_over_artifact }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
		exists = scope:target
		exists = scope:target
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = hand_over_artifact } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:renunciation }
		scope:recipient = {
			liege ?= scope:actor
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { any_claim = { always = yes } }
		exists = scope:target
		scope:recipient = { has_claim_on = scope:target }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = renunciation } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:hush_money }
		scope:recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
		scope:actor = {
			any_secret = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = hush_money } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:price_of_loyalty }
		scope:actor = {
			liege ?= scope:recipient
			is_landed = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = price_of_loyalty } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:blessing_for_a_feud }
		scope:actor = {
			liege ?= scope:recipient
			is_landed = yes
		}
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { liege ?= scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = blessing_for_a_feud } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:clemency_bargain }
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient

				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
			}
		}

		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = fatwa_for_hire } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:fund_the_dawa }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
			}
		}
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_landed = yes NOT = { faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = fund_the_dawa } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:crowning_the_usurper }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = {
			is_independent_ruler = no
			top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
		}
		exists = scope:actor.top_liege
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = crowning_the_usurper } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:pliant_patriarch }
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = pliant_patriarch } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:favourable_omens }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = favourable_omens } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:consecration_rites }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				this = scope:actor.realm_priest
			}
		}
		scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = consecration_rites } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:temple_patronage }
		scope:recipient = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			faith = scope:actor.faith
			OR = {
				is_clergy = yes
				government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
			}
		}
		NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = temple_patronage } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:join_war }
		scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			any_character_war = {
				qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient }
				NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = join_war } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:stay_out }
		scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
		exists = scope:secondary_recipient
		scope:secondary_recipient = { is_alive = yes }
		NOT = { scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = {
			any_character_war = {
				qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient }
				NOT = { is_participant = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = stay_out } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:heavier_tribute }
		scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_tribute_can_rise
			scope:recipient = { tributary_contract_obligation_level_can_be_increased = default_tributary_taxes }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = heavier_tribute } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:lighter_tribute }
		scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_tribute_can_fall
			scope:actor = { tributary_contract_obligation_level_can_be_decreased = default_tributary_taxes }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = lighter_tribute } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:bought_freedom }
		scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = bought_freedom } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:accept_the_yoke }
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = yes
			is_tributary = no
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = qpq_valid_can_be_tributary
			scope:recipient = { can_be_tributary_of = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = accept_the_yoke } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:cast_off_the_yoke }
		scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			is_tributary = yes
			exists = suzerain
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			NOT = { suzerain = scope:actor }
		}
		exists = scope:recipient.suzerain
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = cast_off_the_yoke } }
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_proposed_kind = flag:barter }
		NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
		scope:actor = { is_imprisoned = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		NOT = { qpq_has_active_pact_of_kind_with_trigger = { A = scope:actor B = scope:recipient KIND = barter } }
	}
	trigger_else = {
		always = no
	}
}
